content: .{@-पूरः@} .²1 the navel. .²2 a kind of bodice richly adorned with jewels. ({@-रम्@}) .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a town in Kaliṅga. .²2 the pit of the stomach, or a mystical circle on the navel (also मणिपूरक); तदूर्ध्वे नाभिदेशे तु मणिपूरं महाप्रभम् . … … मणिवद् भिन्नं तत्पद्मं मणिपूरं तथोच्यते <ls>Yogagrantha.</ls>
